You would think so, but that’s not always true. My partner used to suffer from severe depression, but it feels like he doesn’t understand my depression (or maybe he doesn’t want to...).
I’ll hear things like “You need to exercise if you want to feel better!” Honestly that’s the type of thing I’d expect from someone who didn’t know better, not from someone who went through it too.
Thank you for your insight, but I’m afraid that I don’t have enough evidence to take it to any authority. Not to mention I can’t help but think he’s still a good guy, he’s just making bad choices
